plain: Beings he calls "the veterinarians" are said to come and "pluck us out of our bed, play with us," and to have taken one man off his mountain bike and out of his own bed. That man is John Blitch, a scientist who worked for the Pentagon's research agency, telling it as something that happened to him. He links it to a hurricane-like cloud over his house, which he says the beings used as cover to land.
